routines.reason: Revoked 2026-11-02 after the summary-only knowledge flow replaced this queue RPC. The function remains for compatibility but is absent from the assistant RPC allowlist and has no service_role execute grant.

Authorized 2026-10-27 for knowledge image OCR. The CloudBase ai_parse function can execute this SECURITY DEFINER routine only for the matching source ID and random upload capability while the source is extracting; it returns only PNG/JPEG/WEBP bytes and grants no table access. Revoke after replacing the OCR handoff with a server-authenticated path.

The existing pmc18_observer Cloud Function uses app.rdb() as anon. On 2026-10-19, revoking anon and granting service_role caused its real collect invocation to fail with permission denied; restoring anon made it return the already-collected 20-metric snapshot. Keep this exact ACL until PM18 has an independently approved service_role caller migration.
